market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Cautiously optimistic. The action today is a stark contrast to the prior Monday's failed gap-up. The S&P 500's close on Friday above the 50-day and today's follow-through are encouraging. "I think the market is making a stand... the market is set up to move up to another leg higher." (Webby). However, the NASDAQ still needs to prove itself by clearing the downtrend line, 50-day, and 26,000 level.

SPY.technical_action: Retook 50-day Friday, strong follow-through. Close below 50-day is stop.
SPY.story: Broad market S&P 500. The safest way to play a market call.

RSP.technical_action: Trending above 21-day, making new highs. Regression line "step on gas" signal.
RSP.story: Equal-weight S&P 500. Leading index, broad participation.

MAGS.technical_action: Clearing 50-day, low ATR. Ali bought a 3/4 position.
MAGS.story: Magnificent Seven ETF. A balanced way to play the mega-cap tech recovery.

AMZN.technical_action: Powerful earnings gap, breaking out of a "double bottom in spirit." Pivot at 258.08. Webby added Friday and today.
AMZN.story: Mega-cap e-commerce/AWS. Potential new leader of this leg, driven by explosive earnings growth.

HACK.technical_action: Bounce off 50-day, retaking 21-day. Viable buy point Friday with stop at that day's low.
HACK.story: Cybersecurity ETF. One of the only tech spaces showing relative strength.

CIBR.technical_action: Similar to HACK; strong bounce off 50-day. Justin prefers over HACK due to stronger component charts (CRWD, FTNT, PANW).
CIBR.story: Cybersecurity ETF. Same thesis as HACK.

CRWD.technical_action: Bounce off 50-day, now 7.6% above. Use Friday's low or 21-day as stop.
CRWD.story: Cybersecurity leader. Held up better than most tech.

CNQ.technical_action: Double bottom/cup-with-handle setup. Scott owns with a stop at 45.75. Earnings today.
CNQ.story: Canadian Natural Resources. Oil play. Thesis: new normal of higher oil prices.

SNOW.technical_action: Held above 21-day during pullback, now breaking out of a small consolidation. RS line strong.
SNOW.story: Data software. A "held up best" name. Scott likes the company long-term but hasn't been able to handle the trade.

DELL.technical_action: Holding support at the 50-day. Webby's top pick for individual AI exposure if someone "wants heat."
DELL.story: AI server. Best-looking broken AI leader.

NBIS.technical_action: Forming a potential double-bottom. Scott is long, plans to hold through earnings.
NBIS.story: Neocloud/AI compute. Highly speculative. Scott's "hold on to" pick.

XBI.technical_action: Pulling back, RS weakening. First pullback to 50-day not looking ideal yet. Ali wants to see it clear prior highs.
XBI.story: Biotech ETF. Sector is strong, but ETF chart is messy.

LLY.technical_action: Outside day downside reversal. Ali trimmed when it undercut today's low, may trim more ahead of earnings.
LLY.story: Weight-loss drug giant. A core medical leader, but showing short-term distribution.

MSFT.technical_action: Weekly chart looks "horrible," but earnings line is steady. Prefer to play via MAGS rather than direct.
MSFT.story: Mega-cap software. A rotation play, but chart is messy.

SNDK.technical_action: Broken, below 50-day, wide swings. Webby says avoid, too hard to trade.
SNDK.story: Memory/AI hardware. "There are easy trades, hard trades, and trades that are way too hard."
